text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is right around the 
corner. Even so, rest is necessary at 
times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that pushing too hard does no 
good, I decided to schedule a day off for 
her to refresh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~...)
choice_data_list: Guess I'll go grab a bite to eat...
Maybe I should go get something to eat...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The city is decked out entirely in 
Christmas cheer. Cheerful BGM echoes 
through the streets.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fancy running into you here. You alone, 
too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Just out for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was good timing. What are your 
plans now?
choice_data_list: I came to eat a meal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I shall accompany you as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, that's pretty much how it is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Meat sounds good to me. I'll leave finding 
a place to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One thing led to another, and I ended up 
having a meal with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the meal. That was good quality 
meat.
choice_data_list:
You still have vegetables left on your 
plate, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
? You want to eat it? Then I suppose it 
cannot be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an innocent, unquestioning gaze, 
Narita Brian held out her plate with 
leftover vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Just gotta wait for you to finish eating, 
huh? So, what's next?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...? Don't you have somewhere to be?
choice_data_list: Does Brian not have any plans?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My plan is... to refresh myself. I have no 
other business.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is meant to be rest for the Arima, so 
we shouldn't recklessly push ourselves 
physically.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, staying with you is 
much better than twiddling my thumbs 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm with you, Trainer, we can talk 
about racing, making it a truly meaningful 
break. Wouldn't you agree?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Of course there is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Because to me, that is when my heart finds 
peace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After talking with Narita Brian and 
stepping out of the shop, the sky had 
turned completely dark.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Illuminations, huh? The whole world's 
completely wrapped up in Christmas.
choice_data_list:
We ended up talking about nothing but 
racing as usual, though.

Even though our mind ended up completely 
on racing as usual,

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Because that's our everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Just because it's a special day doesn't 
mean we have to do anything special."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
With you here, and me here, we think about 
the races together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
To me, these everyday moments are dearer 
than anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, our strategy for the Arima is 
set. Shall we do a test run on the 
academy's track tonight?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mmuh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not even a single lap?
choice_data_list:
Let's save that desire to run for the 
actual race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Build it up and unleash it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Got it. The Arima Kinen it is, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out to be a fulfilling day as we 
worked toward our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, what about you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Have I managed to become a part of your 
everyday life?
choice_data_list: You're a precious part of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Is that so? Then we are of the same 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Let us resume our daily routine starting 
tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian smiled, looking thoroughly 
satisfied.
